newsitem.title: ALBANIA: SOCCER-ALBANIAN PLAYERS STRANDED BY GREEK FARM BLOCKADE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ALBANIAN PLAYERS STRANDED BY GREEK FARM BLOCKADE.

text.p: Two of Albania's key players will miss their World Cup qualifier against Northern Ireland in Belfast on Saturday because they are stranded in Greece due to farmer's protests which have paralysed the transport network.

Arjan Xhumba and Arjan Bellai, who both play for Greek team Kalamata, were unable to get to Athens to pick up British visas because of road blockades, Albania's assistant coach Faruk Sejdini said on Wednesday.
Another player Sokol Prenga had refused to play because of a row over money dating back to Albania's last match.
Coach Astrit Hafizi has called up three players from domestic clubs, Ilir Alliu, Artan Vila and Alpin Gallo, to replace the missing trio.
Albania were given the green light to face Northern Ireland last week by soccer's world governing body FIFA, which lifted a ban on the country's participation in international football.
FIFA had originally imposed the ban after the Albanian government suspended various soccer officials.
Defenders - Rudi Vata, Saimir Malko, Ilir Shulku, Afrim Tole, Nevil Dede, Artan Vila, Alpin Gallo
Midfielders - Bledar Kola, Altin Haxhi, Ervin Fakaj, Bajram Fraholli, Ilir Alliu,
Forwards - Altin Rraklli, Viktor Paco, Fatmir Vata, Erjon Bogdani
